topics.purpose: Define audit that human purpose/summary/notes do not contradict or introduce hidden semantics absent from machine-readable structure.

semantics.contract_rule: Every audited contract identity/revision is exact.
semantics.hidden_rule: Machine-significant rule present only in prose is a finding.
semantics.contradiction_rule: Human explanation contradicting structured semantics is a finding.
semantics.missing_rule: Meaningful contract lacking useful human explanation may be readiness finding.
semantics.authority_rule: Prose never overrides structured canonical semantics.

invariants.rule: Whole-tree reconciliation operates only on exact accepted/candidate source snapshots, identities, references and declared semantics; it never repairs ambiguity through filename, path order, timestamp, nearest-name or UI layout heuristics.

A contract, closure set or repository remains unlocked/not-ready until all required reconciliation findings for its declared readiness profile are explicitly resolved or accepted through an explicit bounded exception.

hard_gates.condition: LLM rewrites structured semantics from prose automatically
